title: 等你到站
logline: 深夜城郊公交站，跑了一天外卖的老周和等他的女儿小雨在雨夜分享凉包子，最终等来末班车，诠释「抵达本身即团圆」的温情故事。

shots.narrationZh: 深夜十一点，城郊的站台冷得发颤
shots.narrationEn: At 11 PM, the suburban bus stop is bone-chilling cold.
shots.visual: A worn suburban bus stop at night, with a faded advertisement lightbox, puddles reflecting warm yellow streetlights, and blurred traffic light spots from the distant overpass, middle-aged delivery rider Old Zhou squats by the platform edge wearing a worn dark blue windbreaker, his 11-year-old daughter Xiao Yu stands beside him in an oversized school uniform jacket, with an old schoolbag slung over one shoulder and wet hair sticking to her forehead.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉缓低语，语速偏慢，气息裹着夜风凉意，“冷得发颤”重音下沉，句尾带滞重感

shots.narrationZh: 跑了一天的包子，还热乎着半块
shots.narrationEn: The steamed buns he carried all day, half of them are still warm.
shots.visual: Medium shot of Old Zhou breaking a cold steamed bun in half, holding out one piece to his daughter, his worn dark blue windbreaker has rain spots, stubble on his chin, and obvious fatigue lines under his eyes.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速放缓，带着奔波后的温软，“热乎着半块”轻读带暖意，气息轻软如怕碰碎这点烟火气

shots.narrationZh: 雨声里，父女俩压着嗓子说话
shots.narrationEn: In the pouring rain, the father and daughter talk in hushed tones.
shots.visual: Close-up of the two in the rain, Zhou lowers his head as he speaks, Xiao Yu tucks a strand of wet hair behind her ear, holding the half bun in her hand.
shots.ttsDirection: 气息收拢压低声线，语速轻缓，“说话”重音轻颤，藏着克制的牵挂

shots.narrationZh: 等了很久的路，终于亮起了灯
shots.narrationEn: The long-awaited bus headlights are finally approaching from the dark distance.
shots.visual: Wide shot of the father and daughter standing on the platform, a beam of warm yellow bus headlights appears at the end of the road, gradually getting closer.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速稍扬，带着盼头，“亮起了灯”重音轻提，气息裹着点雀跃的亮

shots.narrationZh: 再远的路，都有人等你到站
shots.narrationEn: No matter how far the road is, someone will wait for you at the stop.
shots.visual: Interior of the empty late-night bus, cold white ceiling light, raindrops on the window reflect the father and daughter's silhouettes, they sit side by side quietly, warm street light seeping through the window.
shots.ttsDirection: 语气笃定温暖，语速平稳，“等你到站”重音加重，气息沉而暖，落点稳
